record.body:
## Rationale

The urgent hole after verify-budget is the missing regression gate at phase head, not a smarter inner loop. Shipping background full-suite + head-SHA gate + fix-task routing restores PASS_TO_PASS coverage without designing testmon/path-map selection or a flake policy. Affected tests can land later if the inner loop still hurts.

## Counter-argument

Full #9 (affected tests + flaky marker + tier-2) would make every rerun cheaper and handle `tmux-suite-flake` explicitly. The cost is a larger design surface and delaying the gate until selection policy is settled.

payload.alternatives: Full #9 with testmon/path-map; blocking in-process full suite only
payload.choice: Tier-2 first: background full suite at head + gate + fix tasks; defer affected-test selection and flaky auto-retry
